title: deparia lushanensis
intro: Deparia lushanensis, commonly known as the Chinese spleenwort or lushan maidenhair fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Athyriaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve liver function, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Deparia lushanensis include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides. These constituents may also contribute to the plant's potential in preventing and treating certain diseases, including cancer and cardiovascular disease.
